critique: The render has the intended near-black deep-blue background and a clean cyan particle palette. By t4, the field reaches a readable moderate density with mostly small round luminous particles distributed through the frame, including new bubbles along the bottom edge. However, t1 is extremely sparse, and across the two frames the particles read primarily as glowing dots rather than clearly bubble-like forms. The lateral sway is not visually demonstrable from the displayed motion: the flow appears broadly upward/dispersed, without an obvious side-to-side arc.

suggestions.why: Increase horizontal wind amplitude so the rising paths show a clearly visible slow left-right sway rather than reading as nearly vertical drift.
Strengthen broad turbulence enough to add organic lateral curvature to individual bubble trajectories.
Slightly raise the continuous birth rate so the early portion of the animation is less empty while retaining readable individual particles.
